entities.summary: 1937 Riots and Labour Awakening, a transformative movement in Barbados (1937–1945). Emerged from 1937 labour riots triggered by Clement Payne deportation and Panama Canal Workers and Diaspora. Catalyzed Grantley Adams founds Barbados Labour Party 1938 and West Indies Federation.
